newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian rupiah weakens on ample supply.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian rupiah weakens on ample supply.

text.p: The Indonesian rupiah weakened against the dollar in slow early trading on Friday morning due to sustained ample liquidity, dealers said.
"There are not so many issues operators can trade on at present. Liquidity is still ample, thus driving rupiah yield lower and distracting offshore interest," one dealer said.
Spot rupiah edged down to 2,395.75/96.25 at 0245 GMT from 2,394.25/95.00 at the opening. Tomorrow and today rupiah were at 2,395.5/96.0 and 2,395.4/96.0 respectively.
Overnight rupiah was traded at 5.5/6.0 percent, compared with overnight dollars at 5.625/5.750 percent.
"The underlying tone is biddish on dollars," the dealer said, adding that overall trading was slow.
"It might be due to the weekend factor, but I don't feel comfortable with this quietness. I'm just worried somebody is planning something to drive the market," another said.
Dealers said offshore operators were focusing on Thailand.

Some said they were not clear whether some uptrend in longer-term swaps in the domestic market were due to the Thai factor or due to local issues such as the new reserve rate or the upcoming May elections.
Overnight swap was at 0.10/0.15 and tom/next at 0.10/0.15.
One U.S. bank dealer said some investors were seen squaring positions by buying spot dollars and forwards.
"This is probably a realistic move because you can't expect much from the rupiah at present. The band widening issue is diminishing and interest rates are low," the dealer said.

Dealers said dollar buying was seen from offshore while local operators remained confident and absorbed the rupiah on anticipation of a tighter market and also due to the release of latest economic data which seemed to be within expectations.
Inflation was kept under control while a healthy trade surplus was achieved in December and the whole of 1996.
One-month swaps were at 11.25/12.00, two at 25.0/26.0, three at 36.75/38.00 and six at 77.0/78.0 points.
Bank Indonesia raised its intervention band by one point to 2,385/2,577 and the conversion band to 2,385/2,433 on Thursday, the third this week.
The bank depreciated the rupiah by two points last week after lowering it by three points the previous week.
